title: Function coverage for Write File Record
purpose: Exercise grouped file-record write parsing with one conservative subrequest and corrected total length.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a Write File Record request with one subrequest targeting file 1, record 0, length 2, and two 16-bit data words.
constraints_preserved: length is 000f for unit_id plus 14-byte PDU
byte count 0b matches one subrequest body of reference type, three 16-bit fields, and four data bytes
record length 0002 matches exactly two 16-bit data words
issue_safety_notes: Uses a small internally consistent grouped write rather than an aggressive malformed file-record payload.
